Name: PARTS_TEX_PRESET_PARAM_ST
Description: Texture presets for the layered materials of AC parts. Each row gives the texture ID used for each of the four material layers.

Fields.Name: Layer 1 Material
Fields.Description: Texture ID for material layer 1 (base metal and similar).

Fields.Name: Layer 2 Material
Fields.Description: Texture ID for material layer 2 (base paint).

Fields.Name: Layer 3 Material
Fields.Description: Texture ID for material layer 3 (state after the base paint is applied).

Fields.Name: Layer 4 Material
Fields.Description: Texture ID for material layer 4 (weathering and wear).
